procedure_source_utf8:
"""One recorded issue242 measurement procedure using unchanged pure scan helpers.

This is an explicit evidence action, with no new scanner API and no CLI modes.
The old wrapper's main function is never invoked. All generated values stay private.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import io
import json
import subprocess
import tarfile

private_root = Path('/private/tmp/faction242-native-OWNED')
repository = Path('/Users/cam/DEV/faction-bbs')
candidate = Path('/private/tmp/faction242-client-OWNED/candidate-repository')
new_prefix = 'dev-docs/evidence/mail-search/'
new_root = candidate / new_prefix
selection = new_root / 'payload-selection.json'
selection_sha = '15131090351cccb473315798a28b7c11d52bbf3603d1d66d0dbd325348be1165'
inventory = private_root / 'actual-private-inventory.json'
inventory_sha = 'dd3f9762fed59046e69e67a6b677358058363f0592101046bce335297a7087dc'
helper_sha = 'ba1d518b79e903c560cbc73a1bf6f63f596f7107e7d27d51ab59f6a819c227dc'
helper_record_sha = 'aeb5cd5efaad9b21734f7edbb426534e1f5f89a64e04804d8366990f8982bc91'
kernel_sha = '2080fa293db227b866ecd11dfc9c1ac216070b32717a6c646030613994de8c06'
procedure_path = Path(__file__).resolve()
procedure_bytes = procedure_path.read_bytes()
helper_record_path = candidate / 'dev-docs/evidence/menu-mail-notices/integration/publication-scan-final.json'
helper_record_bytes = helper_record_path.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(helper_record_bytes).hexdigest() == helper_record_sha
helper_source = json.loads(helper_record_bytes)['scanner_source_utf8']
assert hashlib.sha256(helper_source.encode()).hexdigest() == helper_sha
namespace = {'__name__': 'issue242_unchanged_pure_publication_helpers'}
exec(compile(helper_source, 'verified-embedded-ba1d518-publication-helpers', 'exec'), namespace)
sha = namespace['sha']
exact_file = namespace['exact_file']
load_selected = namespace['load_selected']
findings = namespace['findings']
assert namespace['K_SHA'] == kernel_sha
assert sha(namespace['K'].read_bytes()) == kernel_sha
inventory_bytes = inventory.read_bytes()
assert sha(inventory_bytes) == inventory_sha
values = json.loads(inventory_bytes)['values']
assert len(values) == len(set(values)) == 333
selection_bytes = selection.read_bytes()
assert sha(selection_bytes) == selection_sha
selected = load_selected(candidate, selection, selection_sha)
assert len(selected) == 220
new_selected = {name for name in selected if name.startswith(new_prefix)}
assert len(new_selected) == 205
assert len(set(selected) - new_selected) == 15
assert selection.relative_to(candidate).as_posix() not in selected
physical_names_before = {f.relative_to(candidate).as_posix() for f in candidate.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
assert physical_names_before == set(selected) | {selection.relative_to(candidate).as_posix()}
assert len(physical_names_before) == 221
new_names_before = {f.relative_to(candidate).as_posix() for f in new_root.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
assert new_names_before == new_selected | {selection.relative_to(candidate).as_posix()}
membership_before = {name: sha(exact_file(candidate, name).read_bytes()) for name in sorted(physical_names_before)}
references = json.loads(selected[new_prefix + 'source-references.json'])
for wanted, name in references.items():
    assert name in selected and sha(selected[name]) == wanted
embedded = json.loads(selected[new_prefix + 'embedded-source-references.json'])
assert set(embedded) == {helper_sha}
embedded_ref = embedded[helper_sha]
assert embedded_ref['record_sha256'] == helper_record_sha
assert embedded_ref['utf8_field'] == 'scanner_source_utf8'
assert selected[embedded_ref['record']] == helper_record_bytes
frozen = json.loads(selected[new_prefix + 'native/records/frozen-build-source02.json'])
base_commit = frozen['base_commit']
assert base_commit == '306e6c2ae219d54ad3f17e783b9e6051624549db'
assert len(frozen['files']) == 732 and len(frozen['overrides']) == 4
base_names = sorted(set(frozen['files']) - set(frozen['overrides']))
assert len(base_names) == 728
archive_command = ['git', 'archive', '--format=tar', base_commit, *base_names]
base_archive = subprocess.check_output(archive_command, cwd=repository)
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(base_archive)) as archive:
    base_inputs = {entry.name: archive.extractfile(entry).read()
                   for entry in archive.getmembers() if entry.isfile()}
assert set(base_inputs) == set(base_names)
for name in base_names:
    assert sha(base_inputs[name]) == frozen['files'][name]
for name, wanted in frozen['overrides'].items():
    assert frozen['files'][name] == wanted
    assert wanted in references
    source_name = references[wanted]
    assert sha(selected[source_name]) == wanted
    base_inputs[name] = selected[source_name]
assert set(base_inputs) == set(frozen['files'])
# Use actual retained values for poison controls, in memory only.
simple = next(value for value in values if value.startswith('subject-'))
escaped = next(value for value in values if '\n' in value or any(ord(c) > 127 for c in value))
key = next(value for value in values if value.startswith('-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----'))
assert findings(simple.encode(), values)['generated_private_value']
assert findings(json.dumps(escaped, ensure_ascii=True)[1:-1].encode(), values)['generated_private_value']
assert all(findings(key.encode(), values).values())
for magic in (b'FACTVLT1', b'FACTVLT2', b'FACTCP', b'\x7fELF', b'\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe', b'\xfe\xed\xfa\xcf'):
    assert findings(magic + b' poison control', values)['raw_private_key_or_vault']
assert not any(findings(b'public safe control; no member data', values).values())
logical_inputs = {'selected/' + name: data for name, data in selected.items()}
logical_inputs.update({'base-execution/' + name: data for name, data in base_inputs.items()})
logical_inputs['supplemental/payload-selection.json'] = selection_bytes
logical_inputs['supplemental/combined_publication_measurement.py'] = procedure_bytes
assert len(logical_inputs) == 954
private_hits = []
raw_hits = []
for name, data in logical_inputs.items():
    result = findings(data, values)
    if result['generated_private_value']:
        private_hits.append(name)
    if result['raw_private_key_or_vault']:
        raw_hits.append(name)
assert not private_hits and not raw_hits, 'prohibited private material detected; values suppressed'
assert load_selected(candidate, selection, selection_sha) == selected
assert selection.read_bytes() == selection_bytes
assert inventory.read_bytes() == inventory_bytes
assert procedure_path.read_bytes() == procedure_bytes
assert helper_record_path.read_bytes() == helper_record_bytes
physical_names_after = {f.relative_to(candidate).as_posix() for f in candidate.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
assert physical_names_after == physical_names_before
membership_after = {name: sha(exact_file(candidate, name).read_bytes()) for name in sorted(physical_names_after)}
assert membership_after == membership_before
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'archive', '--format=tar', base_commit, *base_names], cwd=repository) == base_archive
membership_sha = sha(json.dumps(membership_before, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode())
record = dict(
    result='pass',
    scope='exact corrected issue242 frozen220 payload refs, base732 execution inputs and two supplementals',
    publication_selection_sha256=selection_sha,
    selected_payload_files=220,
    new_payload_files=205,
    archived_existing_files=15,
    physical_candidate_files_including_selection=221,
    new_root_membership_exact=True,
    base_execution_sources_scanned=732,
    baseline_git_sources=728,
    archived_build_overrides=4,
    base_commit=base_commit,
    baseline_git_archive_sha256=sha(base_archive),
    supplemental_files_scanned=2,
    logical_scan_inputs=954,
    generated_private_values_scanned=333,
    private_inventory_sha256=inventory_sha,
    private_matches=0,
    raw_private_key_or_vault_matches=0,
    actual_generated_value_poison_rejected=True,
    actual_json_escaped_value_poison_rejected=True,
    actual_private_key_poison_rejected=True,
    vault_checkpoint_and_binary_poison_controls_rejected=True,
    safe_control_passed=True,
    explicit_manifest_verified=True,
    source_references_verified=True,
    embedded_helper_reference_verified=True,
    source_and_file_set_unchanged=True,
    private_inventory_unchanged=True,
    membership_before_sha256=membership_sha,
    membership_after_sha256=membership_sha,
    reused_unchanged_pure_helpers=['findings', 'load_selected', 'exact_file', 'sha'],
    helper_source_sha256=helper_sha,
    helper_embedded_record_sha256=helper_record_sha,
    reused_detection_kernel_sha256=kernel_sha,
    old_issue239_main_invoked=False,
    new_scanner_api_added=False,
    procedure_command=['python3', str(procedure_path)],
    procedure_source_sha256=sha(procedure_bytes),
    procedure_source_utf8=procedure_bytes.decode(),
    receipt_bytes_also_scanned=True,
    later_derived_metadata_scanned=False,
    owned_roots_deleted_by_this_scan=False,
)
receipt_bytes = (json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n').encode()
assert not any(findings(receipt_bytes, values).values())
output = private_root / 'combined-publication-scan.json'
assert not output.exists()
output.write_bytes(receipt_bytes)
output.chmod(0o600)
print(json.dumps(dict(result='pass', receipt_sha256=sha(receipt_bytes), selected_payload_files=220,
                      base_execution_sources_scanned=732, logical_scan_inputs=954,
                      private_matches=0, raw_private_key_or_vault_matches=0,
                      source_and_file_set_unchanged=True)))
